parole.testo: From Middle High German bū, bou, from Old High German bū, ultimately from Proto-Germanic *būą (“building, dwelling”). The plural form Bauten is that of the related Low German Bude (“building”), from Middle Low German bûwete. The singular Baute did not catch on in standard German.

parole.significato: to work sloppily, carelessly, without proper concentration or commitment
parole.testo: From Middle High German slūdern (“to sway”), related with schleudern (“to swing, hurl”). Perhaps ultimately from a group of words derived from Proto-Germanic *slūm- (“loose, slack, flabby”), such as English slumber. Compare also Dutch slodderen (“to be sloppy”). The form with -u- follows Low German
